$comment: PvP Arena unranked duels (plugins/minigames/duelarena/). Captured: rsprox 20261106T111454, 20261107T010112, 20261107T022508 and 20261107T023226 (rev 242.1, world 578 PvP Arena): challenges both ways, the duel screen's two steps, copying a load-out, cancelling from either side, six fights (wins, a death, forfeits on both sides), the exits, the supplies chest and load-out sharing.
Load-out values are indices into enum 4390 (item) and 4389 (spellbook: 0 Ancient, 1 Standard, 2 Lunar); the defaults are what the supplies chest first sent (20261106T111454 tick 251).
Not captured: a disconnect mid-fight (a forfeit, as Legacy Duels count it) and the time limit running out (both leave, nobody wins).

Ranked 1v1 Duels: rsprox 20261107T115758, 115923 (seven fights), 121755 (an ignored invitation), 122426 (abandoning at the staging steps) and 122509 (an opponent who never came), world 578. Wiki: Elo-style ranking from 2,500 (here K 50, which gives the captured 25 between equal ranks), the tiers, 16 points a win plus 1 per win of the streak (10 at most), 12 a loss, 15,000 at most of either, the weekly build rotation.

characterAttributes.$comment: Per-character attributes the fight starts afresh and Stash puts back (key -> the arena's starting value): the ring of recoil's damage count, the imbued heart's cooldown.

ranked.$comment: Captured: the invitation takes 15 rank (pvpa_upfront_paid); arriving owes it back (pvpa_owed_join_refund); once both are up each gets it back and stakes what a loss costs (25 between equal ranks); a win returns the stake with the gain. An ignored invitation lapses after 566 ticks and keeps the 15; the one who came gets theirs back. The staging timer starts at 299. Reminders every 10 ticks, the popup every 20. The pairing interval and the abandon's opponent outcome are inferred. world: the number the gateway lists this world under (GatewayTarget.WORLD_ID). tiers: [title, from, the board's Rank icon]; captured: the steel scimitar for Steel (objectbox, zoom 400); the other metals follow, the Dragon tiers a dragon scimitar (inferred).

rotation.$comment: Wiki: the ranked build rotates weekly, Tuesday to Wednesday midnight UK; Zerker the week of 2026-11-04. The order after it is inferred.

staging.$comment: A copy of the staging room per pair (live copies the whole hospital, unrotated). Landing tiles by the steps taken; leaving lands outside the hospital.

group.$comment: The 1v1 Duels group as captured: the clan's name, owner and channel key, clan setting 33 (its battletype), its creation, and the chatbox's loading texts.
